🔍 DEBUGGING STEPS:
1. Open one of the URLs above in your browser
2. Open browser DevTools (F12)
3. Check Console tab for logs:
   - Look for "[useIntegrationsAccess]" logs
   - Look for "🔑" auth token logs
   - Look for "🧪 Checking access" logs from API
4. Check Network tab:
   - Look for POST to /api/subscription/check-access
   - Check request/response details
